entities.summary: Timur Kacharava (b. 1985-08-21, Kyiv Oblast) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kyiv Oblast. Known in the fields of composers & musicians.
